messages.name: SERVICE REQUEST or EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST or CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST

notes: To initiate the procedure the EMM entity in the network requests the lower layer to start paging
T3415 for this paging procedure, if the network accepted to use eDRX for the UE and the UE does not have a PDN connection for emergency bearer services
Otherwise, T3413 for this paging procedure

If the network detects that the pending user data to be sent to the UE is related to the voice service and decides to initiate the paging procedure based on the stored paging restriction information, the EMM entity should request the lower layer to include the Voice Service Indication in the Paging message
If the network starts timer T3415, the network shall set timer T3415 to a value smaller than the value of timer T3-RESPONSE
